messages:
Ava (Finance): Heads up: invoice 98732 for ProHealth Labs ($62,400) failed ACH. Bank returned `account name mismatch`. Need guidance: manual retry, re-collect ACH, or accept wire? Also >$50k so finance sign-off needed for wire.
Darren (Billing Ops): Which Stripe event id?
Ava (Finance): stripe_evt_3K8aWqX — bank message: "account_name_mismatch: beneficiary_name does not match account holder"
billing-bot: Payment method status changed for customer prohealth-labs, last4: ****2345, event: payment_failed
Darren (Billing Ops): Quick check: customer submitted ACH as "ProHealth Labs Inc". Bank holds name as "Pro Health Labs" (space). Microdeposit verification never completed.
Priya (CS): I'm on with the customer in ~20m. I'll ask if they'd prefer to re-submit ACH with legal name or send a wire. Want to avoid credit hold.
Ava (Finance): If wire: need PO + signed SOW + Hector approval. If ACH: re-initiate microdeposits and confirm legal entity name (match bank).
Darren (Billing Ops): Stripe log snippet:
```
2026-03-23T15:02:12Z stripe: bank_account_rejected code=account_name_mismatch invoice=98732 amount=62400
```
Darren (Billing Ops): Recommendation: don't auto-retry ACH more than once in 24h to avoid bank blocking. Manual retry only after customer confirms name.
Priya (CS): Customer treasurer prefers wire. They said they can email bank remittance PDF and PO within 2 hours. I'll escalate collection to their procurement contact.
Ava (Finance): @Hector can you approve one-off wire release for this invoice once we have PO+SOW+remittance PDF? Also confirm AML/KYC steps.
Hector (Finance Dir): Approved conditionally. Require PO, signed SOW, bank remittance PDF showing amount and beneficiary, and confirmation that beneficiary name matches SOW. Run standard AML vendor screen (sanctions check + beneficial owner).
Darren (Billing Ops): Creating internal ticket and hold: billing ticket #3482, hold applied to invoice 98732 (reason: ACH name mismatch). Will set attempts=1 and next_action=await_docs.
billing-bot: Manual payout task created: payout_5591 status=pending_review assigned_to=Darren
Priya (CS): I'll DM the PDF to Darren + Ava when it arrives. If they want a temporary credit extension while docs are collected, say so.
Ava (Finance): We can allow a 48-hour payment window extension pending docs, but mark A/R for follow-up. Will not clear until wire confirmed.
Darren (Billing Ops): For audit: record failure_code=account_name_mismatch, initial_attempts=1, customer_contacted=true, preferred_method=wire.
Priya (CS): Call ended — customer confirmed treasurer will send PO + remittance. Sharing notes in support ticket.
Ava (Finance): Thanks. Once docs in, I'll trigger manual payout and update invoice status to pending-wire. Keep channel posted. :+1:
